title: Mimi's Ender IO Conduits
description: Retexture & remodel of EnderIO conduits to make them match the pixel density of Minecraft.
body:
# Mimi's Ender IO Conduits

Have you ever looked at [Ender IO](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ender-io) conduits and thought to yourself that they look really out of place? If so, this is the resource pack for you!

![Mimi's Ender IO Conduits](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/320becd0609f6944a2e9e33a96a326d7b263ac85_0.webp)

This pack redoes the base Ender IO conduits (item, power, fluid, redstone) and some builtin mod compatibility conduits as well (Mekanism, Refined Storage, Applied Energistics 2). The only part of the pack that doesn't adhere 1:1 to Minecraft's pixel density is the directional arrows at the base of connectors, which I gave twice the texture size since it was more important IMO to make them readable.

Note that some z-fighting will occur when cramming a lot of conduits in the same space since conduit connection spacings can't be changed with a resource pack alone.
